items.summary: Financial recommendation: reject immediate admission of both live-site changes; retain them as capacity-gated only until CTO reconciles the conflicting ledger by 2026-10-01T18:00Z. The 2026-10-01 AI snapshot reports $22.1593508 across only 17 of 38 expected instrumented sites, so fleet AI spend and cost-to-learn are incomplete. The 2026-09-21 Amazon window reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all on aggregate tracking_id other; site-attributed income is $0, so no site revenue, ROI, contribution-margin, or upside claim is supported. Shoptopless.com and reviewtattoo.com have descriptive baselines of 85 sessions/1 conversion and 57 sessions/1 conversion, but no attributable revenue or causal forecast. Contribution margin and budget exposure are not calculable because direct infrastructure, domain, labor/implementation-time, monthly budget, fixed-cost, and complete site-level revenue data are unavailable. Minimum measurement before execution: reconciled capacity, registered tracking IDs mapped to site/content, direct cost and implementation effort by change, and post-change conversions plus attributable commission over the stated 14-day or 100-relevant-session window. No spend, billing, credential, configuration, or production admission is authorized by this review.
